args.sql:
SELECT 
    p.panemark AS site_name,
    p.hubregistry AS panel_id,
    p.initdate AS start_date,
    p.gencapmw * p.serviceyears AS service_years,
    p.paneeffpct AS efficiency_values,
    perf.anndegrate AS annual_degradation_rate,
    perf.efflosspct AS efficiency_loss_metric,
    (perf.cumdegpct * 100) AS calculated_NDI,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.panetype ILIKE '%PERC%' THEN 'PERC'
        WHEN p.panetype ILIKE '%HJT%' THEN 'HJT'
        WHEN p.panetype ILIKE '%Bifacial%' THEN 'Bifacial'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS panel_category
FROM 
    plant p
JOIN 
    performance perf ON p.growregistry = perf.solmodref
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    p.panemark AS site_name,
    p.hubregistry AS panel_id,
    p.initdate AS start_date,
    p.gencapmw * p.serviceyears AS service_years,
    p.paneeffpct AS efficiency_values,
    perf.anndegrate AS annual_degradation_rate,
    perf.efflosspct AS efficiency_loss_metric,
    (perf.cumdegpct * 100) AS calculated_NDI,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.panetype ILIKE '%PERC%' THEN 'PERC'
        WHEN p.panetype ILIKE '%HJT%' THEN 'HJT'
        WHEN p.panetype ILIKE '%Bifacial%' THEN 'Bifacial'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS panel_category
FROM 
    plant p
JOIN 
    performance perf ON p.growregistry = perf.solmodref
LIMIT 10;
